description: This file defines a PHP class SubunitAPI within the OrangeHRM project, implementing API endpoints for managing organizational subunits including CRUD operations and retrieval of subunit tree structures. It incorporates detailed API documentation annotations, validation rules, and interaction with the service layer.

classes.name: SubunitAPI
classes.description: A REST API controller class providing CRUD operations and retrieval functionalities for Subunit entities within the organization's structure. Implements endpoint methods, validation, and API documentation annotations for Swagger/OpenAPI.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves details of a subunit specified by ID, returning a SubunitModel wrapped in EndpointResourceResult.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all subunits, optionally in a tree structure, based on query parameters 'depth' and 'mode'.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new subunit under a specified parent subunit, validating input parameters.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing subunit's details identified by ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a subunit by ID, with validation to prevent deletion of the top organization node.
